name: Pubrio
desc: Enrich company and people data, monitor changes, and get notified with Pubrio.

actions.name: search_companies
actions.description: Search B2B companies by name, domain, location, industry, technology, or headcount

actions.name: lookup_company
actions.description: Look up detailed company information by domain or LinkedIn URL

actions.name: enrich_company
actions.description: Get enriched company data with full firmographic details (uses credits)

actions.name: search_people
actions.description: Search business professionals by name, title, department, seniority, or company

actions.name: lookup_person
actions.description: Look up a person's professional profile by LinkedIn URL or Pubrio ID

actions.name: reveal_contact
actions.description: Reveal email or phone number for a person (uses credits)

actions.name: search_jobs
actions.description: Search job postings across companies

actions.name: search_news
actions.description: Search company news and press releases

actions.name: find_similar_companies
actions.description: Find companies similar to a given company by domain or LinkedIn URL

actions.name: lookup_technology
actions.description: Look up technologies used by a company

actions.name: linkedin_person_lookup
actions.description: Real-time LinkedIn person lookup by LinkedIn URL

actions.name: search_ads
actions.description: Search company advertisements and ad campaigns

actions.name: linkedin_company_lookup
actions.description: Real-time LinkedIn company lookup by LinkedIn URL

actions.name: lookup_job
actions.description: Look up detailed job information by job search ID

actions.name: lookup_news
actions.description: Look up detailed news information by news search ID

actions.name: lookup_advertisement
actions.description: Look up detailed advertisement information by advertisement search ID

actions.name: lookup_lookalike
actions.description: Look up a similar company result by domain, LinkedIn URL, or domain search ID

actions.name: batch_redeem_contacts
actions.description: Reveal email or phone numbers for multiple people at once (uses credits)

actions.name: query_batch_redeem
actions.description: Query the status and results of a batch redeem operation

actions.name: create_monitor
actions.description: Create a new signal monitor for jobs, news, or advertisements

actions.name: update_monitor
actions.description: Update an existing signal monitor

actions.name: get_monitor
actions.description: Look up a monitor by ID

actions.name: list_monitors
actions.description: List all monitors with pagination

actions.name: delete_monitor
actions.description: Delete a monitor by ID

actions.name: duplicate_monitor
actions.description: Duplicate an existing monitor

actions.name: test_run_monitor
actions.description: Perform a test run of a monitor

actions.name: reveal_monitor_signature
actions.description: Reveal the signature for a monitor (uses credits)

actions.name: custom_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint

triggers.name: pubrio_monitor_event
triggers.description: Triggers once per signal (signal_first mode) or once per company (company_first mode) when a Pubrio monitor fires. Copy the webhook URL into your Pubrio monitor destination configuration.
